author: Cleo Abram
description:
If you rip open the new World Cup ball you’ll find this sensor embedded into the side

It’s collecting data 500 times a second! During games, the sensor tells you where the ball is on the field and if it’s been touched by a player!

This high tech ball helps track things like offsides or out of bounds or if a ball crossed the goal line

To see sports tech that got BANNED for being TOO GOOD, subscribe!

title: Secret Sensor Hidden Inside World Cup Ball
